latest_release.body:
# WattSeal v1.1.0

This release brings a major step forward for WattSeal, with broader hardware support, more reliable energy monitoring, new integration possibilities, and a smoother experience across platforms.

## Highlights

### ⚡ Improved hardware monitoring
- Improved detection and monitoring of multiple GPUs, including NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel hardware.
- Native AMD GPU monitoring on Linux.
- More reliable CPU and GPU measurements, with improved estimation when direct hardware readings are unavailable.
- Better hardware identification and more detailed component information.
- Improvements to RAM, disk, network, and per-process monitoring.

### 📊 More accurate energy tracking
- Transition to energy-based measurements throughout the collection and storage pipeline.
- Improved accounting across variable sampling intervals.
- Historical charts now display energy consumption in Wh, while real-time monitoring retains power readings in W.
- Automatic migration of existing databases, preserving previously collected history.

### 🏠 MQTT and Home Assistant integration
- New headless mode to run WattSeal without its graphical interface or system tray.
- MQTT publishing with configurable broker connection, authentication, and TLS.
- Home Assistant automatic MQTT discovery.
- Dedicated Home Assistant mode with energy reporting in Wh.
- Configurable MQTT identifiers and measurement units.

### 🖥️ Better everyday experience
- Configurable process list limits to control the amount of displayed process information.
- Optional launch-on-startup support on Windows.
- Improved background and system tray behavior, with configurable window-closing behavior.
- Automatic language detection based on the operating system.
- Platform-specific data and log directories, with support for custom data locations.

### 🌍 Localization and regional settings
- Expanded translations, now supporting English, French, German, Romanian, Simplified Chinese, and Brazilian Portuguese.
- Improved country selection and regional defaults.
- Local currency support for electricity cost estimates.
- Additional country, currency, and carbon intensity presets.

### 📦 Easier installation and distribution
- New Windows installer, alongside the portable executable.
- Linux AppImage packaging, alongside the portable executable.
- Native macOS disk image (`.dmg`) packaging for Apple Silicon.
- Improved and streamlined cross-platform build and release workflows.

---

WattSeal continues to provide local, real-time visibility into your computer's energy consumption, helping you understand where your electricity goes, down to individual applications and hardware components.

Thank you to everyone who contributed, tested, reported issues, and helped improve WattSeal!

## What's Changed

* feat(ui): add Iceland country preset and ISK currency by @devalberg in https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/pull/167

### See where your PC's power actually goes, live, by app and by component. Available in English, Français, 简体中文, Português, Deutsch and Română. [![Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-x64-00cce6?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,)](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/releases/latest/download/WattSeal-windows.exe) [![Linux](https://img.shields.io/badge/Linux-x64-e6b300?style=for-the-badge&logo=linux&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/releases/latest/download/WattSeal-linux.AppImage) [![macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-Apple%20Silicon-111111?style=for-the-badge&logo=apple&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/releases/latest/download/WattSeal-macos.dmg) ![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FDaminoup88%2FWattSeal%2Fgh-pages%2Fdownload_count.json&label=Downloads&query=%24.downloads&color=blue&style=for-the-badge)
--- ## Why use WattSeal? Most people have no idea how much electricity their computer actually uses, or which apps are silently draining power in the background. WattSeal gives you that visibility: - ⚡ **Live power draw**, updated every second - 🧩 **Per-component breakdown**: CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, network - 📋 **Per-app breakdown**: catch the process quietly draining your battery - 📈 **History**: charts from the last minute to the last year - 🔒 **100% local**: all your data stays on your machine, private - 🏠 **MQTT + Home Assistant** ready, for anyone who wants it in their smart home dashboard - 🌍 **Carbon & cost estimates** based on your grid and electricity price - 🪶 **Lightweight** (near-zero overhead), single executable available --- ## Quick start WattSeal is a single executable. No installer, no dependencies to manage. Download the executable for your OS below and run it: | OS | Download | |---|---| | 🪟 Windows (x64) | **[WattSeal-windows.exe](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/releases/latest/download/WattSeal-windows.exe)** | | 🐧 Linux (x64) | **[WattSeal-linux.AppImage](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/releases/latest/download/WattSeal-linux.AppImage)** | | 🍎 macOS (Apple Silicon) | **[WattSeal-macos.dmg](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/releases/latest/download/WattSeal-macos.dmg)** | Admin/root is optional everywhere. Without it, WattSeal still runs fully, CPU power just falls back to a usage-based estimate instead of a direct hardware reading. ### Step by step instructions Detailed instructions for each platform are below.
🪟 Windows 1. Download and double-click [`WattSeal-windows.exe`](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/releases/latest/download/WattSeal-windows.exe). 2. Follow the installation procedure and start the app at the end. If SmartScreen warns you, click **More info → Run anyway**. This is normal as we did not pay Microsoft to notarize the app. 3. If prompted by User Account Control (UAC) to install the CPU MSR driver, click "Yes" to install it (this is a one-time step). If you click "No", WattSeal will still run but CPU power readings will be estimated. The dashboard opens in a window and a tray icon is added. Closing the window keeps WattSeal running in the tray, reopen it from there.
🐧 Linux Download [`WattSeal-linux.AppImage`](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/releases/latest/download/WattSeal-linux.AppImage), make it executable if needed, and run it as sudo (recommended) or as a normal user. Or download [`WattSeal-linux-portable`](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/releases/latest/download/WattSeal-linux-portable) and run it from the terminal: ```bash chmod +x WattSeal-linux-portable sudo ./WattSeal-linux-portable ``` Root is needed to read `/sys/class/powercap` for CPU energy. Tray icon requires `libappindicator` or `libayatana-appindicator`; without either, WattSeal just runs without one.
🍎 macOS 1. Download and open [`WattSeal-macos.dmg`](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/releases/latest/download/WattSeal-macos.dmg). 2. Drag `WattSeal.app` onto the Applications shortcut in the opened window. 3. Open WattSeal from Applications. If macOS blocks the app because "Apple could not verify if it's free of malware", go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and allow WattSeal to run. It is normal as we did not pay Apple to notarize the app.
--- ## Documentation Quick reference, everything deeper lives in the **[Wiki](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/wiki)**: | | | |---|---| | 🖥️ [Platform Support](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/wiki/Platform-Support) | What's measured directly vs. estimated, per OS | | ❓ [FAQ & Troubleshooting](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/wiki/FAQ-Troubleshooting) | Common issues, quick fixes | | ⌨️ [CLI Reference](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/wiki/CLI-Reference) | Flags, headless mode, background mode | | 📡 [MQTT Integration](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/wiki/MQTT-Integration) | Publish live data to a broker | | 🏠 [Home Assistant Integration](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/wiki/Home-Assistant-Integration) | Wire WattSeal into your smart home | | 🔬 [Sensor Sources](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/wiki/Sensor-Sources) | Formulas and citations behind every reading | | 🏗️ [Architecture](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/wiki/Architecture) | Crate layout, database, data flow | --- ## Contributing Issues and PRs are welcome, small or large. See **[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)** to get started and **[ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md)** for what's planned. To translate WattSeal into your native language, see **[🌏 App translations](https://github.com/Daminoup88/WattSeal/issues/112)**. The following languages are currently supported: | Language | Status | Contributor | |---|---|---| | English | ✅ Fully supported | [Daminoup88](https://github.com/Daminoup88) | | French | ✅ Fully supported | [Daminoup88](https://github.com/Daminoup88) | | Chinese (Simplified) | ✅ Fully supported | [metahubaifeel](https://github.com/metahubaifeel) | | Portuguese (Brazil) | ✅ Fully supported | [alisonpSWE](https://github.com/alisonpSWE) | | German | ✅ Fully supported | [LivingPixel-pixel](https://github.com/LivingPixel-pixel) | | Romanian | ✅ Fully supported | [CodrinSocol](https://github.com/CodrinSocol) | ## License WattSeal is licensed under [GPL-3.0](LICENSE). --- If WattSeal is useful to you, a ⭐ helps other people find it.
